packageRules.description: The Go devcontainer tag carries the image version and the Go version, as in 2-1.27-bookworm. Only the image version moves here, Go goes up together with go.mod.
Docker: auto-merge digest pins and digest refreshes (same tag, new build). Major and minor stay open for review.
The compose file is for people to copy, so it follows the app's own latest tag instead of a digest that goes stale every build
